Yes, we do have the sparkr-dev@ mailing list: spark...@googlegroups.com. Feel free to post future questions / feedback there (further that forum subscribes to all JIRA updates).

For the RStudio issue, simply do:

> library(SparkR, lib.loc = "/path/to/your/installed/SparkR-pkg/lib")
